body.name: Fithandle
body.def: On \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit one raw unrestricted-support tensor-product B-spline product likelihood, align its common permutation by the empirical modal criterion, support-clean and renormalize both measurement fits at \(\tau_{S,n}\), and recompute every bridge, posterior, projector, Gram object, and score from that cleaned law using \(\tau_G=\varepsilon/2\)
body.role: Non-oracle starting move for a coherent support-cleaned nuisance construction whose likelihood rates and feasibility remain to be proved.
